name: visual-notes
description: Agent side of Visual Notes: a skill for authoring concept-map sidecars, commands for agent or plugin extraction, and a hook that conforms and pins agent-written sidecars so the Obsidian plugin renders them.

visual_notes_enabled.title: Conform and pin agent-written sidecars
visual_notes_enabled.description: After an agent writes or edits a {basename}-overview.json sidecar, conform it to the plugin's strict schema and pin it so the visual-notes fence renders it. Requires python on PATH.
